work_experince.perusahaan: Dinas Perpustakaan Dan Kearsipan DKI Jakarta
work_experince.deskripsi: Designed and developed a web-based Helpdesk Ticketing Information System using the Laravel framework to streamline service request management through four user roles: User, Helpdesk Admin, Technical Staff, and Super Admin. The system features ticket management, SLA tracking, Telegram Bot notifications, and user activity logging to improve the efficiency, transparency, and accountability of the service handling process.
